# Freelance Sales Development Representative - US hours (m/f/d)

## Location

Berlin; Bremen; Frankfurt; Hamburg; Ireland; Krakow, Poland; London; Munich; Paris; Portugal; Warsaw, Poland

## Employment Type

Full time

## Location Type

Remote

## Department

Sales

# **🎤 Why voize? Because we’re more than just a job!**

At voize, **we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present.** Today, that time is lost to **busywork and complex systems** that pull them away from what matters most: **people**.

**Our vision is to change that by building AI companions** that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - **we amplify their impact.**

# **💡 Your Mission: Own the First Contact and Grow the Sales Pipeline!**

We are looking for a proactive and empathetic **Freelance Sales Development Representative (SDR) for the US market** to own the first step of the sales process - identifying potential customers, generating qualified leads, and opening doors for our Account Executives. As the first human touchpoint for prospects, you will play an important role in building a predictable sales pipeline through **meaningful outreaches**. If you love initiating conversations and creating opportunities, this role is for you!

**This is a remote freelance role for someone based in the EU/EEA who is happy to work US hours.**

# **🚀 Your Daily Business: No two days are alike**

- Own outbound for the US healthcare market, from researching accounts to booking a qualified meeting

- Start conversations with decision-makers through cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn, with messages that are personal and not copy-paste

- Make your cold calls during US hours, so you reach prospects when they are at work

- Keep your leads, conversations, and outcomes up to date in our CRM and use our research tools to find the right accounts and contacts


# **🤝 Your Skillset: What you bring to the table**

- Experience in B2B sales or cold calling. SaaS experience is great

- Hands-on experience with outreach (using tools like HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) and familiar with data tools (Clay, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Lusha, Cognism, Seamless.AI)

- Comfort working with AI tools (we use Claude every day)

- Bilingual-level English and excellent communication skills, with the ability to get to the point and make complex topics easy to understand

- Based in the EU/EEA and available during US hours \[e.g. 2pm-10pm CET, adjust to your needs\] and for the weekly US sales meeting


# **✨ Ready to talk? Apply now! 🚀**

We look forward to your application and can’t wait to meet you, no matter who you are or what background you have!

[Apply for this Job](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/voize/3eaed6ab-3bf6-4b6c-810b-db7e1258bdea/application)
